text:
michelle | People Ops: Heads-up — Alex Ramos submitted resignation today. Last day is Fri 2024-06-28. 
michelle | People Ops: Need to coordinate: exit interview, equipment return, access removal, final pay + benefits/Cobra notice.
michelle | People Ops: Benefits note: active through 2024-06-30 per plan terms. COBRA election window = 60 days from termination date (carrier policy). HR will send packet.
michelle | People Ops: Can we please confirm access cutover timing (last working hour vs EOD deprovision)? @jordan @lee @sam

sam | Eng Manager: Thanks — will handle knowledge transfer checklist and schedule a short 1:1 for mon/tue to capture runbooks. Please add me to the exit interview invite.

sam | Eng Manager: Also flagging repos where Alex is owner so we can transfer ownership and rotate any deploy keys.

jordan | IT: For equipment — Alex has a MacBook Pro + Thunderbolt dock + monitor. Want to offer drop-off at HQ or scheduled courier pickup? I can coordinate pickup on 2024-07-01.

jordan | IT: I'll also prepare to revoke SSH keys, reset AnyConnect cert, and stage laptop wipe after retrieval.

lee | Security: For access removal, plan is: 1) disable SSO/Okta at EOD 2024-06-28 18:00 PT, 2) disable GitHub access and remove from org teams, 3) revoke GCP/infra IAM keys and rotate any shared service accounts touched by Alex.
lee | Security: Please list any personal service accounts Alex had access to (e.g., analytics-admin, infra-deploy).

michelle | People Ops: Alex uses BCBS Standard PPO (employee plan) and Dependent coverage ends same day as employee coverage. 
tara | HRIS: I will send the COBRA packet and final benefits termination notice. COBRA vendor: Benum Benefits. Target send date: 2024-06-29.

tara | HRIS: Final paycheck (accrued PTO) will be processed on next payroll cycle; I'll confirm dates with payroll.

michelle | People Ops: Exit interview — prefer a quick 30-min with me + optional skip-level invite from Sam. Alex indicated willing to do a virtual exit on 2024-07-02 afternoon.

hr-bot: Offboarding checklist created: https://redwood.internal/offboarding/12345 — auto-reminders scheduled. :white_check_mark:

jordan | IT: Quick reference (example commands for infra deprovision):
```
# example (do not paste directly in prod)
okta-cli deactivate-user --email alex.ramos@redwood.com
github org remove-member redwood-org alexramos
revoke-ssh-keys --user alex.ramos@redwood.com
```

lee | Security: We'll coordinate a short window to rotate deploy tokens that Alex had access to. @sam please flag any critical pipelines that must not be interrupted.

sam | Eng Manager: Noted — I will inventory pipelines tonight and post names here.

michelle | People Ops: Action items summary:
- michelle: schedule exit interview for 2024-07-02, send final separation email + COBRA details
- tara: send COBRA packet and confirm final payroll/PTO payout schedule
- jordan: coordinate laptop pickup on 2024-07-01, revoke device certs, stage wipe
- lee: disable Okta/SSO at EOD 2024-06-28, revoke infra keys and rotate shared tokens
- sam: transfer repo ownerships, list critical pipelines, run quick knowledge-transfer 1:1

michelle | People Ops: Please update the offboarding checklist link with any changes. Ping if anything blocks. Thanks! :pray:
